items.metric: LIVE GMV (week Sep 14 to 20, third week of decline, largest fall in the set)
items.effect: 103 streams produced 543.74, or 5.28 per stream against 18.06 in the prior week, so live is a yield problem rather than a scheduling one.
items.action: Re-brief the creators holding the top streams and hold stream count near last week's 103 instead of adding volume.

items.metric: Collab invites sent (third week of decline, upstream of sampling)
items.effect: Invites halved while 9,585 DMs went out, and the daily rows show 0 invites on Sep 18 and Sep 19, so inbound demand starves the sample stage two weeks out.
items.action: Restart invites this week toward the prior week's 12,221 using the existing outreach lists before changing message content.

items.metric: Sample requests (third week of decline, rejection rate 58.7%)
items.effect: Requests fell 47.3% while 176 of 300 requests were rejected, so more than half of inbound sample demand never reaches a shipment.
items.action: Clear the 12 pending reviews today, highest post rate first, and re-screen the 83 expired items for creators who still post.

items.metric: GMV (week Sep 14 to 20, fourth consecutive decline, 9 metrics in three-week runs)
items.effect: The week closed at 602.63 GMV per day against 1,030.93, and orders, units, affiliate GMV, invites, DMs and samples delivered are all in three-week runs.
items.action: Track the Sep 21 to 27 week against the 602.63 daily run and keep sample approvals and shipping moving as the only levers that reach October GMV.

items.metric: GMV Max Back to School campaign ROAS against its 5.4 target
items.effect: The campaign spent 289.66 for 83.97 of revenue, a 205.69 loss before commission and COGS, on 3 orders at 96.55 each.
items.action: Pause or reallocate the 289.66 of weekly spend into Screen Door at 2.000, the only campaign clear of breakeven and nearest its target.

items.metric: Sample pipeline rejection rate (week Sep 14 to 20)
items.effect: 176 of 300 requests were rejected and 83 expired, so the funnel discards inbound demand faster than it converts it and caps content supply into November.
items.action: Screen on post rate and GPM before rejecting, and treat rejection and the 13.68% refund rate as one screening and listing issue.
